layers.process: Pay at the gate. Adult admission to Christoffel Park is USD 15 (about A$21.31, RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040); children 6 to 12 pay USD 2 and under 6s are free. Residents with a Sèdula (local ID) pay a lower local rate. The ticket counter closes at 1:30 pm. Carmabi also manages the Curaçao Marine Park, Shete Boka and the Mangrove Park; fees for those were not found on its own pages.
